answer: Clone Sink Mechanism**: Each agent must solve a unique lotus puzzle upon registration, where puzzle complexity scales with the number of existing clones from the same origin. The zephyr of new registrations triggers periodic recalibration of puzzle tiers, ensuring marginal clones face exponentially rising effort. Attackers pay in wasted computation—each duplicate’s puzzle becomes a nebula of entangled dependencies, rendering additional clones net-negative as they must re-solve all prior puzzles with higher difficulty. The enforcement rule burns 50% of failed attempts’ work as a sunk cost.
